title: Palantir Jumps After ‘Otherworldly’ Demand Lifts Outlook
summary: Palantir Technologies Inc. shares rose in premarket trading after the company boosted full-year revenue and income forecasts and described commercial demand for its data analytics tools as “otherworldly.”

title: CoreWeave to Enter Asian Market With Indonesian Data Centers
summary: AI cloud company CoreWeave Inc. is entering the Asian market with its first data centers in the region, expanding to a rapidly growing part of the world that is clamoring for more computing power.

title: Mag 7 Valuations Have Room to Normalize, Dawson Says
summary: Cameron Dawson, CIO at NewEdge Wealth, discusses the turnaround in technology stocks as she sees room for Magnificent Seven stock valuations to move higher and give a lift to the overall tech sector and S&P 500. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Zepto’s IPO Hopes Were Chilled by Investors Looking for Profitability
summary: Public markets demand a path to profitability before they buy in

title: Nvidia, Dell Back AI Cloud Startup Volta at $2.4 Billion Value

title: Bending Spoons to Buy Software Firm Airtable For $2.3 Billion
summary: App developer Bending Spoons SpA has agreed to buy software firm Airtable for an equity value of $2.25 billion, a sharp decline from the startup’s 2021 peak valuation.

title: Spotify Falls After User and Income Forecasts Miss Estimates
summary: Spotify Technology SA shares fell in premarket trading after the world’s largest music streaming service gave disappointing forecasts for active users and operating income in the third quarter.

title: Apple Finally Gets into the Chatbot Race with Siri AI
summary: Siri’s pre-installed status could also make it one of the world’s most widely used AI assistants almost overnight.

title: Ex-Nubank Executives Launch AI Wealth Adviser in Brazil
summary: An artificial-intelligence startup founded by two former Nubank executives is launching a financial-advisory service in Brazil, encouraged by consumers’ rapid adoption of innovations such as the Pix instant-payment system and digital banking.

title: AI Power Demands Spur Builders to Seek Billions in Bank Pledges
summary: Power utilities across the US are already strained from AI data centers. But they’re increasingly facing an even bigger threat: that developers will be forced to walk away from projects, leaving households on the hook for massive infrastructure bills.

title: BlackRock Overweight AI Despite Higher Risks, Li Says
summary: "We have not changed our conviction in the overall AI thesis," BlackRock Global Chief Investment Strategist Wei Li tells Bloomberg Television. She adds that risks of commoditization and capital capacity have risen in recent weeks. "We're not adding to our conviction, but we're staying overweight," she says.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: MediaTek-Backed African Fintech PalmPay Eyes Hong Kong IPO
summary: Africa-focused fintech PalmPay Ltd., valued at more than $1 billion in an ongoing funding round, is preparing for a potential Hong Kong initial public offering, according to people with knowledge of the matter.

title: CXMT Narrows Gap With SK Hynix and Samsung in Smartphone Memory
summary: China’s state-backed CXMT Corp. is poised to produce smartphone memory chips that are on par with the industry’s most advanced designs, highlighting the speed at which Beijing is gaining ground in a field critical for AI deployment.

title: Snap Projects Strong Sales Growth Ahead of AR Glasses Debut
summary: Snap Inc. posted higher-than-projected quarterly sales and gave an upbeat forecast for the current period, signaling optimism ahead of the September commercial debut of its first pair of augmented reality glasses.

title: NAB Sticks to Safer US AI Models as Chinese Rivals Kept At Bay
summary: National Australia Bank Ltd. is staying with US-built AI models for now, as its technology chief says Chinese systems may lack the ethical restrictions that are placed on the largest US developers.

title: Apple’s India Sales Top $10 Billion on Widening Retail Push
summary: Apple Inc. exceeded $10 billion in annual sales in India for the first time last fiscal year, underscoring surging demand for its pricey devices in a market where it’s steadily ramping up its retail network.

title: Huawei’s Top Scientist Warns of Chip Limit Nvidia Will Soon Face
summary: Huawei Technologies Co.’s top semiconductor scientist warned of the looming physical limits Western chipmaking giants including Nvidia Corp. face in their pursuit of more powerful processors, in a rare public appearance streamed in China.

title: Chinese Startup AI² Robotics Is Said to Consider Hong Kong IPO
summary: Chinese robot maker AI² Robotics is considering an initial public offering in Hong Kong, according to people familiar with the matter, looking to tap into interest for the growing sector.

title: BlackRock Launches Tokenized Money Market Funds in Europe
summary: BlackRock Inc. is bringing blockchain technology to its flagship money market funds in Europe, in the latest sign of Wall Street’s growing ambition to expand use of digital-asset technology in mainstream finance.

title: Apple Briefly Removes Telegram App for Child Abuse Content
summary: Apple Inc. briefly removed the Telegram messaging app from its App Store after finding content on the platform that violated a ban on child sexual abuse material.
